draft.heroMessage: Guiding you home in Summerville and the Charleston Lowcountry.
draft.welcomeNote: Welcome! I'm Alena Goncharov, dedicated to making your transition to life in the Lowcountry smooth and rewarding. Whether you're moving across town or relocating to a new state, let's make this next step one you'll love.
draft.tagline: Your local real estate partner for new beginnings in Summerville and beyond.
draft.aboutParagraph: With over six years of real estate experience and a professional journey that spans from Charlotte to the beautiful Lowcountry, I bring clients deep local knowledge and a passion for both new construction and residential homes. Having grown up surrounded by home renovations and construction, I see the true potential in every property. My extensive background—including my time as the top sales consultant with Pulte Group—gives me a unique edge in guiding buyers and sellers to smart, informed decisions. Fluent in English, Russian, and Ukrainian, I enjoy serving a diverse clientele and helping everyone feel at home in our vibrant Charleston communities. As a Summerville resident myself, I’d love to help you find the lifestyle and neighborhood
draft.conciergeLine: Thinking about your next move? Reach out—I'm here to answer your questions and expertly guide you through every step.
draft.contactLine: Let's connect! Call me at (704) 604-5280 or email alena.goncharov@cbrealty.com to get started.
draft.tone: Warm, knowledgeable, and welcoming—focused on local expertise and a personal approach.
